title: Camilla — Jupiter cruise recreation · EVdvEEJ
note: Camilla-inspired recreation of the supplied 2026-2031 planetary calendar days, ending at Jupiter. The explicitly modeled July 2027 DSM is 313.75 m/s; launch C3 is 11.915 km2/s2. Chariklo encounter and impactor deployment are outside this case. Flyby altitudes are inferred from asymptotic turns; the preview/downloads join planet centers and require the desktop finite-radius exporter for Celestia close-ups. Launch injection and Jupiter capture are excluded.
